evidence_boundary: The supplied visual reference is visual grammar only; no ImageGen output is treated as operational evidence.
one_sentence_story: A pinned source artifact emits one luminous trace; a transparent context capsule holds it, the trace becomes a torus-family candidate with a highlighted cusp hexagonal fibre, and only a returning world trace plus receipt closes the S6 paper claim as a claim.

beats.visual_action: A warm paper-like source artifact rises from an amber hexagonal stratum at frame-left and locks to a small circular anchor.
beats.causal_move: The source is pinned before any interpretation appears.

beats.visual_action: One thin amber filament leaves the anchor, undulates across the hexagonal terrain, and acquires evenly spaced hash ticks.
beats.causal_move: The pinned source produces one visible trace; no branch or second stream is introduced.

beats.visual_action: A transparent upright capsule grows around the filament at frame-center; the filament passes through unchanged while a single context ring appears inside.
beats.causal_move: The capsule separates context from the source trace without replacing the trace.

beats.visual_action: Inside the capsule, three restrained torus outlines appear as a family; their shared center tightens into one outlined hexagonal cusp fibre, while the outer filament turns cyan.
beats.causal_move: The held context is rendered as a geometric candidate, not as a consensus result.

beats.visual_action: A dotted cyan world trace returns from the cusp to the original source anchor; hash ticks fill a closed luminous receipt volume, and the final lock reads as a bounded claim.
beats.causal_move: The claim closes only after the return trace and receipt seal are both visible.

caption_script.text: Start with the source, not the answer.
Context can hold a trace without becoming its proof.
The S6 geometry is shown here as a paper claim — not consensus fact.
It closes only when the receipt returns to the source.

frame.coordinate_space: Manim frame x=-7..7, y=-3.94..3.94; use camera.frame_width=14

geometry_construction: Build 11 fixed hexagonal Polygon strata from a literal coordinate list; no noise or runtime sampling.
Build the evidence thread with one ParametricFunction and a deterministic 12-dot hash tick group sampled at fixed t values.
Build the capsule with transparent Prism faces and one Circle ring; keep fill_opacity <= 0.12 until B5.
Build the torus family with three fixed minor_radius values and a fixed rotation; build the cusp fibre from one regular hexagon plus six short radial segments.
Build the receipt seal from a rounded Rectangle, eight fixed hash ticks, and one Arc return arrow; do not use generated text or texture.
Use MathTex only for the short literal labels S6 CLAIM — CANDIDATE and RECEIPT + WORLD TRACE; use Text for all other captions.

timeline.animation: Create trace with ShowPassingFlash, then reveal fixed hash ticks
Grow capsule, then Create inner ring; trace remains continuous
Create torus family, Transform shared center into hexagonal cusp, recolor trace
MoveAlongPath return trace, fill receipt hash ticks, then FadeIn bounded claim label

manim_plan.legibility_gate: At 1920x1080 every label is <= 2 lines, uses no pseudo-text, and the final claim label remains readable with the receipt visible.
manim_plan.reduced_motion: Replace path animations with sequential opacity changes while preserving all five settled states and the final return-trace relation.
manim_plan.render_receipt_requirement: A future render must record the exact Manim command, output path, frame count, and sha256; this candidate is not a render receipt.

falsifier.claim_under_test: The visual makes a bounded S6 paper claim legible as a receipt-gated candidate rather than a consensus fact.
would_refute: A first-pass viewer cannot recover the five-step order source -> trace -> context -> candidate geometry -> receipt.
The receipt seal can become opaque before the return world trace reaches the source anchor.
The words PAPER CLAIM or S6 CLAIM — CANDIDATE are absent, unreadable, or visually outweighed by a definitive result statement.
The torus family or cusp fibre is mistaken for measured evidence because the scene offers no visible source pointer or receipt boundary.
falsifier.test_boundary: This is a film-concept falsifier; it does not validate the mathematical S6 claim.
